verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships 'llmster', explicitly documented as a headless daemon 'for servers, cloud instances, and CI' with no desktop app required, plus a CLI (lms server start/stop, lms load, lms chat) and REST API for scripting. Community commentary (comm-17) corroborates that the headless flow makes local inference usable from real tools rather than just a GUI demo. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of llmster specifically in a CI pipeline, and explicit CI/Docker integration examples beyond CLI reference.
